condition: Acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding — unstable, on warfarin
summary: 81-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation on warfarin (INR 4.6) with heavy fresh and dark rectal bleeding, HR 112 and SBP 86: interrupt warfarin and reverse with prothrombin complex concentrate and IV vitamin K, then CT angiography.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Heavy bleeding from the back passage
inputs.hpi: Four large bloody stools since this morning, dark red with clots and some fresh blood; dizzy on standing. No haematemesis. Atrial fibrillation on warfarin; recent course of clarithromycin for a chest infection. No abdominal pain. Previous colonoscopy (4 years ago): diverticular disease.

exam.general: Pale, drowsy but orientated. HR 112 irregularly irregular, BP 86/50 after 500 mL crystalloid.
exam.other: PR: dark red blood and clots, no mass.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Acute lower GI bleed — unstable, supratherapeutic INR on warfarin
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Major acute lower GI bleed, haemodynamically unstable, on warfarin with INR 4.6. Needs reversal and CT angiography.

mustInclude.note: BSG 2019: interrupt warfarin at presentation; in unstable bleeding reverse with prothrombin complex concentrate and IV vitamin K.
BSG 2019: plan when to restart warfarin (the guideline suggests about 7 days after the bleed in most patients) — the thrombotic risk of AF persists.

guideline.name: BSG guideline — diagnosis and management of acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding
guideline.section: Anticoagulants: interrupt warfarin; reverse with PCC and vitamin K in unstable haemorrhage; restart after the bleed; CTA first when unstable
guideline.citation: Oakland K, Chadwick G, East JE, et al. Diagnosis and management of acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding: guidelines from the British Society of Gastroenterology. Gut. 2019;68:776–789.

rationale: Permutation: warfarin with a supratherapeutic INR. Checks that the anticoagulant is surfaced as a red flag and that reversal is part of the plan, not only the generic "hold DOAC 48 h pre-op" bridging text.
